kāyadaratha.p: [Kāya+daratha] (pu) CL=7 Anxiety of the body. (A) Anxiety of the material body. (B) The anxiety of three aggregate embodying such as the pain or suffering of Nāmakāya. See also - Kāyacittadarathapassambhana.
